captions.detailed: A modern steel campanile bell tower featuring a tall, dark gray square lattice shaft resting on a light gray square concrete base. The top of the tower is capped with a flat, square dark gray roof. Inside the upper open section of the lattice tower, a bronze-colored conical bell is suspended from a horizontal support beam, allowing it to swing back and forth on a revolute hinge.
captions.instruction: Generate a modern steel campanile bell tower with a tall, square lattice frame structure, a flat top cap, and a concrete base. Inside the upper section, suspend a bronze-colored bell from a horizontal beam using a revolute joint so it can swing about the horizontal axis.
captions.factory: The code constructs a tower assembly consisting of a concrete base box, a tall square lattice tower composed of vertical columns and crossed diagonal struts, and a flat top roof plate. Inside the upper portion of the lattice, a crossbeam assembly is modeled to support the bell. The bell is created as a conical shape with a top cylindrical headstock and is connected to the tower frame via a revolute articulation joint to enable swinging motion.
